Class SlotMachineContestCTest

java.lang.Object
SlotMachineContestCTest
public class SlotMachineContestCTest extends Object
Shared unit tests for SlotMachineContest, compatible across group implementations since they verify invariants any correct solution to the contest problem must satisfy, rather than implementation details specific to one group's algorithm.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Oscar Poveda, Elian Ibarra

    • accordingMurtestSolveDontHaceSpin0

      @Test public void accordingMurtestSolveDontHaceSpin0()
      What should it do? Ensure the returned action list is not null, stays within the 10000-action limit, and never includes a zero-step spin (a spin that doesn't change any wheel's state). What shouldn't it do? Return a null list or include 0-step spins.

    • accordingCcIcsolveShouldReturnAnEmptyPlanForOneWheel

      @Test public void accordingCcIcsolveShouldReturnAnEmptyPlanForOneWheel()
      Verifies that solving a machine with a single wheel returns an empty action plan, since a lone wheel is trivially always a jackpot (there is nothing else to match it against).
